D: A burnt-out cop hunts escaped replicants in a rainy future Los Angeles.
P: Serve the noodles when Deckard sits down at the street noodle bar in the rain.
S: Pan fried pork and cabbage gyoza with a soy and chili oil dip
Pork and cabbage gyoza pan-fried until crisp, steamed under a lid, soy and rice vinegar dip with chilli oil.
Rice paper triangles fried until puffed, dusted with shichimi togarashi
Rice paper sheets cut into small triangles, fried at 180C for a few seconds until they puff, tossed in shichimi and salt.
Neon salmon and avocado inside-out rolls

Inside-out rolls of salmon, avocado and cucumber, coated in bright tobiko and toasted sesame, sliced and served with soy, wasabi and pickled ginger. Rinse 400g sushi rice, cook with 480ml water, then fold in 80ml rice vinegar mixed with 1 tbsp sugar and 1 tsp salt and cool. Lay half a nori sheet on a mat covered in cling film, spread with rice and flip so the rice is underneath. Lay strips of 250g sashimi salmon, avocado and cucumber along the middle and roll tight. Roll in 50g tobiko and sesame. Slice each roll into 8 with a wet knife.
M: Deckard's noodle bar prawn tempura udon
Deckard asks for four, he gets two

Thick udon in a hot dashi broth seasoned with soy and mirin, topped with crisp prawn tempura, spring onion and a pinch of shichimi. Heat 1.6 litres water with 2 tsp dashi powder, 4 tbsp soy sauce and 3 tbsp mirin to a simmer. Whisk 100g plain flour, 1 tbsp cornflour and 180ml ice-cold soda water until just mixed. Dip 12 peeled green prawns in flour, then the batter, and fry at 180C for 2 minutes until crisp. Cook 4 packets fresh udon for 2 minutes and divide between bowls. Ladle over the broth and top with prawns, spring onion and shichimi.
Braised pork belly ramen with soft-boiled egg, nori and spring onion
Pork belly braised in soy, mirin and sake until tender, sliced over ramen in a chicken and pork broth with a jammy soy egg, nori and spring onion.
W: Thin crisp sesame cookies folded into shapes while still warm
Sesame tuile batter (egg white, sugar, flour, melted butter) spread thin, baked at 180C for 6 minutes, folded into shapes while hot.
K: Japanese whisky and soda water over ice with a lemon peel twist

Japanese whisky poured over a tall glass packed with ice, topped with very cold soda water and finished with a strip of lemon peel. Pack 4 tall glasses to the top with ice and stir with a bar spoon for 10 seconds to chill the glass, then pour off any water. Add 45ml Japanese whisky to each and stir 10 times. Top slowly with 150ml very cold soda water, pouring down the spoon to keep the bubbles. Stir once and squeeze a strip of lemon peel over each glass.

s.note: Crisp-bottomed pork and cabbage gyoza with chilli dipping sauce
s.how: Mix 400g pork mince with 2 cups finely shredded cabbage, salted and squeezed, plus soy and ginger. Fill 30 gyoza wrappers and pleat. Fry until crisp underneath, add water and steam with a lid for 4 minutes. Dip in soy, rice vinegar and chilli oil.

s.note: Puffed rice paper triangles with shichimi and salt
s.how: Cut 10 rice paper sheets into small triangles with scissors. Fry a few at a time at 180C for a few seconds until they puff and turn white. Drain and toss with flaky salt and a good shake of shichimi togarashi.

m.note: Soy-braised pork belly ramen with jammy eggs and nori
m.how: Braise 600g pork belly in 125ml soy, 125ml mirin, 125ml sake and 500ml water for 2 hours, then slice. Marinate 4 soft-boiled eggs in some of the liquid. Cook 4 serves ramen into 1.5L hot stock seasoned with soy. Top with pork, egg, nori and spring onion.

w.note: Thin sesame tuiles folded into shapes while hot
w.how: Whisk 2 egg whites with 100g sugar, then stir in 50g flour, 50g melted butter and 2 tbsp sesame seeds. Spread thin circles on a lined tray and bake at 180C for 6 minutes. Fold or twist into shapes while still hot and soft.
